Definition: from G797; lightning; by analogy, glare:--lightning, bright shining.
BiblicalUsage: Lightning is how Jesus describes His coming, flashing from the east even to the west, and how He saw Satan fall from heaven. The angel at the tomb had a countenance like lightning, and lightnings come out of the throne in John's vision.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the lightning tells the truth about power: it is sudden, it is seen by all, and no one can mistake it for anything else. Christ's return will be like that, and I hold that the safest place to be when it flashes is on His side.
